notes:
Inbound SMB; small tools startup building a docs search + support assistant for their SaaS dashboard. Self-serve signup, no sales touch until AE outreach. Key points:
- Signup/referral: developer docs article sent traffic -> trial signup 2026-02-16.
- Setup: CTO (Evan Morris) spun up sample embed pipeline; used node SDK; index ~120 docs; sample chat flow wired in web UI.
- Usage: very low after initial test runs (~2k tokens/day peak), dropped to <500/day after 2/22.
- Pain: quoted: "Works fast, but need predictable per-query cost — we're tiny margins". Cost sensitivity high; will default to the cheapest credits.
- Performance ask: wants P95 latency <150ms for short queries; concerned about multi-region fallbacks adding 100-200ms.
- Security: wants SOC2 or equivalent assurance, SSO for admin console; flagged as blocker for procurement even though Hosted API is fine for now.
- Competitive motion: CTO told us they activated Anthropic and OpenAI credits; testing Anthropic for cheaper embed throughput.
- Technical notes: saw occasional 429s when running batch embed jobs (developer used naive parallelism). Suspect rate-limiter config and missing batching guidance.
- AE notes: initial demo showed Optimize suggestions could cut cost 30% via batching/prefix caching — but customer didn't run the recommended workload profiler.
- Quote from CTO on call: "We want a clear path to control token spend — show me numbers by endpoint and we'll commit."
- Linked artifacts: ff_20260301_8472 transcript, trial pricing deck, security FAQ.
- Jira: INF-4521 created for rate-limit guidance; SE recommended code snippet to serialize embed requests, shared 3/2.
- Current status: trial at-risk/partially churned — moved baseline traffic to Anthropic for embed tests.
Next suggested actions:
1) Offer 30% extra trial credits valid 30 days + a short ROI calc comparing per-query unit costs (include batching savings).
2) Quick SE office hours (30m) to fix 429s and show profiler + Optimize suggestions in-app.
3) Provide SOC2 summary + how SSO can be enabled in paid plan; optionally escalate to product for SSO timeline if needed.
4) If re-engaged, request a short shared promptset and sample 48hr traffic to run cost simulation and routing recommendation.
